summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases (URL built as `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`), extracts the binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then uses that Bun binary to execute a shipped `math_init.js` file (~727 KB) via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })`. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle whose logic is hidden behind a shuffled string-array obfuscator (a `WV8StW` rotate function driving a ~2000-entry constant table `n7gIxM`), preventing inspection of what the payload actually does once executed. `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-named identifiers and string-property indirection consistent with the same obfuscator. The package is advertised as micro-frontend test utilities, a purpose that has no need for a downloaded Bun runtime or an obfuscated 727 KB binary blob. The alien runtime also places execution outside the visibility of Node-only tooling on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
